fusions.name: Exact Ignition
fusions.desc: Throws a bead of flame that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, always as a critical hit, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Singe
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 7 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Juggler's Coals
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds. For the first 8 seconds, burning coals strike your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Muscle Memory
fusions.desc: Your ability cooldowns are 8% shorter, and you have 10% fire resistance.
